programs.description: Govindankutty faces several obstacles after he inherits an ancestral property which often results in hilarious situations.
Peter, a young man, is madly in love with Devi who gets married to Jayakumar. When Jayakumar dies in an accident, Peter decides to tell Devi about his feelings.
Vrinda, a rich young woman, falls in love with Vasu, a poor man. However, he rejects her advances due to his financial status.
Mukundan, a young man seeking a bride, meets Seethalakshmi and falls in love with her. However, his newfound affection is threatened by Raghavan who wishes to marry Seethalakshmi.
Manu, Meera, Rafeeq, Ashok and Vijayakumar study together in a college. The five friends share a close bond and are always willing to fight for each other.
Raja and his father, who live in Hong Kong, are devastated when an accident leaves the latter on the verge of death. He decides to reunite his father with his grandfather in order to make him happy.
Priya is furious to learn that her alcoholic husband, Sathyanadhan, is in love with Neena. Things deteriorate further after she files for divorce and her family takes some foolish steps.
When a military doctor tracks down his former fiancée's kidnapped niece, he discovers a complex human trafficking ring in Goa. He then weaves an intricate trap to capture the perpetrators.
Lal is an orphan who continues studying in a college even though he has earned three master's degrees. Things turn sour for him when he is framed for a crime he did not commit and put in jail.
A filmmaker is found dead under mysterious circumstances. Years later, his son, Adi, a successful writer, digs into his past and tries to demystify the reason for his father's death.
After he witnesses his entire family getting murdered over a video call, Surya decides to avenge their deaths. His fiancée, Gayathri, who is mourning the death of her brother, is ready to help him.
In a village, an Ayurvedic doctor is famous for predicting people's death by feeling the pulse of the patient. However, the villagers realise the truth when an allopathic doctor reveals the secret.
Two friends, Ananthan and Appukuttan, set out to make a name for themselves. After losing their jobs, they venture into the real estate business and meet a girl who changes their lives.
When Jagadeesh welcomes his old friend, Sethumadhavan, into his home because he does not have a place to stay, he invites his stepmother Bhanu's wrath.
Pradeep marries Roshni without his family's consent. However, Roshni decides to move to her friend Shailaja's house with Pradeep, unaware that she is Pradeep's sister-in-law.
Charles and his group of men hijack a bus filled with politicians and demand the release of their colleagues from prison. An ex-police officer, Ali Imran, is summoned to solve the problem.
A hard-working postwoman lives a contended life with her adopted son. However, her simple life is jeopardised after her beloved son is imprisoned under a false charge.
A car that Mahadevan wins in a contest brings him bad luck, and he soon gets involved in a murder. As he tries to find a car with the same license number as his, he unravels a shocking truth.
